name: branding-lime-real-estate-billboard-mockup
title: Lime billboard with giant faint monogram and photo panel of UI overlay
whatItIs: A slide with a rounded photo of a roadside billboard among trees. The billboard has two rounded panels in a dark teal frame: a lime one with a large faint 'A' monogram, logo and headline 'Your smarter way into real estate', and a photo of a smiling woman with a phone and floating UI cards.
whatItMeans: Confident and modern; lime pops strongly against the dark trees and asphalt.
techniques: Split a billboard into a colour panel and a photo panel with rounded corners.
Use an oversized faint monogram inside the colour block.
Layer UI cards on the photo to show the product.
Shoot the mockup in dark natural surroundings so lime stands out.

vocabulary.definition: A large low-contrast initial used as a watermark.
A billboard divided into two panels.
UI elements placed on a photo.
